note.zh: 在相同隔离配置下，通过 AntiGravity CLI 1.1.5 的精确选择器 gemini-3.6-flash-high（High）使用仓库标准中文提示词一次生成的完整 Vite、React、TypeScript 与 Three.js 工程。公开仓排除依赖与构建目录，站点以原始源码执行 Vite 预览构建。该预览构建成功，项目自带的严格 TypeScript 检查存在两处错误并按测评规则原样保留。原生系统提示正常启用，未注入 AGENTS.md、额外上下文文件、外部 Skill、插件或 MCP，外部 URL 与 Web Search 动作被阻断；由于 AntiGravity 没有可验证的内置 Skill 与上下文发现总开关，隔离状态为 partial。CLI 未回报运行时模型 ID，归因依据为已选择的精确模型档位。本页为修复后的构建（1 行）：原始产出在寻路上有一处致命 bug，位于 src/game/NavMesh.ts 第 155 行的 A* 判断 gScore.get(neighborId) || Infinity。起点的 gScore 是 0，而 0 在 JavaScript 中为假值，0 || Infinity 求值为 Infinity，起点因此被误判为从未访问，任一邻居都会把起点反向设为自己的父节点，cameFrom 中形成二元环；第 137 行的回溯循环 while (curr) 没有 visited 集合，遇环即无限循环并持续分配对象。修复前行为：地图上十个 bot 出生即巡逻寻路，页面在第一帧就锁死主线程、CPU 长期满载，且因产物 iframe 与父页同源，会连带冻住整个站点标签页。以该工程真实的 28 个航点做全量验证：756 组有序航点对中原始实现有 688 组回溯成环，仅 68 组正常；将该处 || 改为 ?? 后成环 0 组、756 组全部正常。仅改这一行，其余代码包括上述两处 TypeScript 错误均未改动。
note.en: A complete Vite, React, TypeScript, and Three.js project generated one-shot from the repository's canonical Chinese prompt under the same isolated configuration using AntiGravity CLI 1.1.5 with the exact gemini-3.6-flash-high selector (High). Dependencies and generated build directories are excluded from the public repository, and the site runs its Vite preview build from the raw source. That preview build succeeds, while two errors from the project's own strict TypeScript check are retained as generated under benchmark rules. The native system prompt remained enabled, no AGENTS.md, extra context files, external skills, plugins, or MCP were injected, and outbound URL and Web Search actions were blocked. Because AntiGravity has no verifiable master switch for bundled skills or context discovery, isolation is recorded as partial. The CLI did not report a runtime model ID; attribution is based on the exact selected catalog entry. This page shows the fixed build (1 line): the original output had a fatal pathfinding bug at src/game/NavMesh.ts line 155, in the A* guard gScore.get(neighborId) || Infinity. The start node's gScore is 0, and 0 is falsy in JavaScript, so 0 || Infinity evaluates to Infinity and the start node reads as never visited; any neighbour then re-parents the start node onto itself, creating a two-node cycle in cameFrom, and the reconstruction loop while (curr) at line 137 has no visited set, so it spins forever and keeps allocating. Pre-fix behaviour: ten bots begin patrol pathfinding at spawn, so the page wedged its main thread on the very first frame with the CPU pinned indefinitely, and because the artifact iframe is same-origin with its parent it froze the whole site tab as well. Verified exhaustively against the project's real 28 waypoints: of 756 ordered waypoint pairs the original implementation produced a reconstruction cycle for 688 and completed for only 68; changing that one || to ?? yields 0 cycles and 756 clean paths. Only that line was changed; everything else, including the two TypeScript errors above, is untouched.
